completionContract.instruction: When your final user-visible answer is complete, output __JOI_DONE__ on a line by itself. Do not output anything after it.

firstTurnPrefix: Read task-goal.json / definition-of-done.json / lesson-plan.md / clone-manifest.json from the trigger event's attaches_artifact list.
Repos are already provisioned at {workspace.dir}/repos/<repo_id> by mount projection from `joi thread create --bootstrap-artifact`; do not clone manually.
Use `joi event append` for user-visible replies and handoff.
Use `joi workspace read/write` for your scratch state under {workspace.dir}.
Use `joi artifact publish` for diff bundles, MR descriptors, and validation evidence.
Use `joi action request` for any human approval (publishing an MR, mutating production data, etc.).
Listen for mr-event-*.json artifacts emitted by the mr-detector service before finalising the turn.
everyTurnSuffix: When finished, emit the configured Joi completion sentinel.
